{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing 0.5-0.8 unit lag that narrows as prices stabilize",
    "When sentiment is positive ( >0.5), model under-forecasts more severely due to delayed sentiment incorporation",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive causes the largest forecast-error divergence from reality",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias targeting mid-point of price ranges rather than directional momentum",
    "As prices rise, forecast error margin increases as model bases expansion on older low-base data",
    "Sentiment history shows clustering effects - periods of uniform sentiment (0.67-1.00) produce more consistent forecast errors",
    "When prices are in uptrend, model forecasts lag 1-2 days behind true price movement"
  ]
}
